notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where achievement notifications would pop up at incorrect times
- Fixed a bug where volume settings are not applied at the start of the game
- Fixed a bug where open dyslexic font does not appear on the checkpoint reached notification

notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.notes:
- Fixed various bugs with achievement hunting
- Fixed a bug where players can remain invincible for the final part of the Archives
- Fixed a bug where the settings load later on certain machines
- Fixed a level geometry bug in the Archives

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where the progression screen did not appear correctly on lower resolutions
 Fixed an issue where players were unable to set their resolution settings
